_comment: Ranking variants for `npm run eval:retrieval -- --compare eval/comparisons/ranking.json` (docs/evaluation.md, 'Ranking experiments'). The first entry is plain RRF, the reference. The variants differ only in how candidates are ranked; the confidence policy is the same everywhere, so the false-positive / false-negative columns show how each ranking feeds the gate. Weights and the exact-token bonus are in units of the best single-ranking contribution 1/(k+1). Calibration decides; validation is only reported.
